svg.title: The best-predictor branch is open at zero by zero cost and positive cutoff. Every connector is near one and the weighted connector average equals one at zero. Near zero the actual predictor is focus of this analytic average, whatever fallback tag was supplied. Its derivative is the weighted sum of these Lie-algebra connector derivatives, unchanged by the focus projection. Expanding tap and the original rooted path and probe definitions gives, coordinate by coordinate, X
